settings.get_involved_intro: Wetlands, mangroves and green spaces last longest when the people around them pay attention. Here are a few simple ways to start.

get_involved_photo.alt: Illustration of a lake shore with a row of newly planted saplings, a wooden boat and three filled waste sacks after a clean-up.

causes.name: Wetlands
causes.description: Marshes, creeks, lakes and floodplains that hold floodwater, clean water and shelter wildlife.
causes.image_alt: Illustration of a wide blue wetland with a flock of birds flying under soft clouds.

causes.name: Mangroves
causes.description: Coastal forests that protect shorelines and shelter young fish and crabs.
causes.image_alt: Illustration of mangrove trees standing in shallow water on arching roots.

causes.name: Lakes
causes.description: Lakes, tanks and ponds in our towns that store monsoon rain and recharge groundwater.
causes.image_alt: Illustration of a city lake at sunset with buildings along the far shore and reeds in the water.

causes.name: Sacred groves
causes.description: Village forests protected by tradition that hold rare plants and feed local water sources.
causes.image_alt: Illustration of a dense green grove with sunlight falling between the tree trunks.
